item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President reports to Congress that a separate executive order was issued and summarizes its legal effects and delegated implementation authority; this segment does not itself impose those effects.","evidence":"I hereby report I have issued an Executive Order"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President describes the separate order’s entry suspension and transmits a copy to Congress; the segment itself is a report and enclosure communication.","evidence":"I am enclosing a copy of the order I have issued."}]}
